paper_id: An Empirical Study on Deployment Faults of Deep Learning Based Mobile Applications
title: An Empirical Study on Deployment Faults of Deep Learning Based Mobile Applications
motivation: 移动端深度学习应用被数十亿用户使用,但部署故障特征尚未被充分研究
problem_framing: 从Stack Overflow和GitHub收集304个部署故障,通过人工标注构建症状分类体系
key_insight: 48.4%的部署故障发生在模型转换阶段,其中不支持的操作是最常见症状(占转换阶段31.3%)
method_signature: 经验性研究,手动标注故障样本,归纳式构建层级症状分类树(23类)
evaluation_criteria: 标注一致性(Cohen's Kappa),故障类别频率分布,修复策略出现频次
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 数据准备和模型更新阶段样本很少,因为移动端训练计算资源需求大且框架支持不足
evidence_for_taste: most frequent category in the model conversion stage
a post is assigned to all related categories
model quantization reduces the precision representations
the remaining three frequent fix strategies have been described
A post is assigned to all related categories if it is related to multiple faults
thinking_moves: 从开发者社区的实际问题中归纳故障模式
通过层级分类树揭示部署过程的多样性故障
将修复策略与症状类别建立对应关系
对比TensorFlow Lite和Core ML的故障分布差异
